title: rhoai-nightly-updater chart values
description: Every object accepts only the keys listed here, so a misspelled key fails the render. Every image is pinned by digest: Argo CD has no install.sh to resolve one. scripts/test-chart.sh checks that parameters lists exactly the parameters of deploy/template.yaml.

parameters.description: The OpenShift Template's parameters, by their exact names. Unset ones take the Template's default; NAMESPACE defaults to the release namespace and INSTALL_METHOD to gitops.

IMAGE.description: Required. The updater image of this chart's release, pinned by digest: <repository>@sha256:<digest> or <repository>:<tag>@sha256:<digest>. A tag naming another release fails; the digest is not verified.

NAMESPACE.description: The app's namespace; must be the Argo CD destination namespace (the default).

APP_NAME.description: The name of the app's objects.

PULL_SECRET_NAMESPACE.description: The namespace of the cluster pull secret.

OAUTH_PROXY_IMAGE.description: Required. The oauth-proxy image pinned by digest; its tag must match the cluster's OCP minor version (<repository>:v4.<minor>@sha256:<digest>).

IMAGE_REPOSITORY.description: The repository the update check reads release tags from; empty turns it off.

INSTALL_METHOD.description: Set to gitops by the chart; leave it unset.

allowTemplateMismatch.description: Turn off the tag-consistency check, which refuses an IMAGE whose tag names another release than this chart's. It compares the tag only; it does not verify the digest.

gitops.description: The hooks that replace install.sh's imperative steps.

cliImage.description: The image of the hook Jobs (they run oc), pinned by digest.

sessionSecret.description: A Sync hook Job that creates Secret <APP_NAME>-proxy once.

consoleLink.description: A PostSync hook Job that applies ConsoleLink <APP_NAME>-<NAMESPACE>.
